english.title: Organise / take part in demonstration / assembly likely to obstruct / interfere with Airport / persons using Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[organised]_
(B)_[took part in]_

a demonstration, protest, procession or public assembly which was likely to obstruct or interfere with the proper use of Bristol Airport or the comfort and convenience or safety of passengers or persons using Bristol Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4.17 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
